caption: The drawing depicts a wooden high chair with four tall legs, a seat, a back with two horizontal slats, and turned finials topping the backrest posts. The wood is shaded in various tones of brown, with some darker and lighter areas, and subtle blue-gray highlights, indicating texture and the grain of the material. The construction includes horizontal rungs connecting the legs at several levels, enhancing stability, with the lowest rung connecting all four legs at the bottom. The high chair is centrally placed on a pale, off-white to beige background, with a faint rectangular border sketched around the image. The artist's signature is present in the lower right corner.
title: Child's High Chair
